node.title: Re^3: Bug in Class::Struct?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
scalar context won’t materialize a zero though. Does change the undef to an empty string

Actually, it kind of does: the match operation [id://1215373|changes its return value] based on context, so the special [id://11104607|false] value returned in scalar context is zero in numeric context. (So it's also not changing the undef to an empty string, it's changing the behavior of the match.)
